content.value: In an oil gas turbine installation, air is taken at pressure of a 1 bar and 27°C and compressed to a pressure of 4 bar. The oil with a calorific value of 42,000 kj/kg is burnt in the combustion chamber to raise the temperature of air to $5 5 0 \mathrm { { \circ } } _ { \mathrm { { C } } }$ If the air flows at the rate of 1.2 kg/s; find the net power of the installation. Also find air-fuel ratio. (Assume Cp=1.05 kj/kgk.)

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
